hero.title: Connecting Every Drop With a Life in Need.
hero.description: BloodCare is a smart blood management platform that connects donors, blood banks and hospitals to make life-saving blood available faster and more efficiently.

mission.title: Technology That Turns Compassion Into Action.
mission.description: We believe no patient should have to wait for blood when every second matters. BloodCare brings the entire blood donation ecosystem together through a simple, reliable and intelligent digital platform.
points: Connect donors with people who need blood
Help blood banks manage inventory efficiently
Enable hospitals to raise urgent blood requests
Reduce delays and unnecessary blood wastage

impact.title: Small Donations. Big Difference.
impact.description: Every donation creates a chain of hope. Together, our community is building a faster and more connected blood-care network.

cta.title: Your Blood Can Be Someone's Second Chance.
cta.description: One simple decision can make a life-saving difference.
